payload.text: hv, 2026-10-25, directly to vc: (1) the next Utilz release is 2.14.4 and carries 0107 and 0108; its pre-release checks start now, in the ruled order: Mac twins, then the Linux twins on kovacs through kovacs-sysadm, then dc's dry run, then hv's cut. (2) vc pushes main before the checks so CI reads it first. (3) molt-vc's desk is the one host queue for every estate on this Mac and kovacs; watchout 17's interleave with intent-vc is retired. (4) dc's kovacs legs no longer ship over ssh: each goes to kovacs-sysadm as a request, with the bundle, the commands and the expected output, and is booked with molt-vc as a heavy.
